title: Keto Orange Pudding Bread Pudding
description: A keto dessert made with orange and bread pudding. Low-carb and delicious.

ingredients.name: Bread
ingredients.notes: Keto-friendly bread, such as almond flour bread

ingredients.name: Orange Pudding
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought keto orange pudding

instructions: Cut the bread into 1-inch cubes and place in a mixing bowl.
Add the orange pudding and mix until the bread is well coated.
Pour the mixture into a 6-inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
